items.title: 8.16.2 Preparation of sulphur trioxide (sulphur trioxide banana) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.16.2, printed pages 184-185, with the second Quick Check 8.6 as self-checks.

blocks.text: H₂SO₄ (sulphuric acid) banane ke liye SO₂ aur O₂ se reversible process mein sulphur trioxide gas banai jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne yahan ΔH = −97.9 kJ mol⁻¹ likha hai. Isi equation ke liye kitab khud topic 8.14 mein −198 kJ, Quick Check 8.6 ki table mein −197 kJ mol⁻¹ aur exercise (MCQ II) mein −197.9 kJ mol⁻¹ deti hai. Sahi value taqreeban −198 kJ hai; reaction har haal mein exothermic hai.

Le-Chatelier ke principle ke mutabiq SO₃ ki behtar yield ke liye zyada pressure aur kam temperature zaroori hain. Kam temperature par SO₃ banne ka equilibrium constant bara hota hai, magar equilibrium bohat slow (dheere) aata hai. Temperature barhane se rate barhti hai magar SO₃ ki yield gir jati hai.
Neeche Table 8.2 dikhati hai ke 1 atmosphere pressure par kya hota hai.

blocks.caption: Table 8.2 Effect of temperature on equilibrium position of SO₃ formation

blocks.text: Reasonable time (munasib waqt) mein SO₃ ki behtareen yield ke liye SO₂(g) aur O₂(g) (hawa) ka mixture 1 atmosphere pressure par V₂O₅ jaise solid catalyst par se guzara jata hai. Reaction exothermic hai, is liye gas ka temperature 600 °C tak barh jata hai. SO₃(g) ki yield barhane ke liye equilibrium mixture ko 400-500 °C ke kam temperature par dobara (recycle) guzara jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Table 8.2 dekh kar batayein ke contact process sirf 200 °C par kyun nahi chalaya jata, jahan 98% SO₃ banti hai.
blocks.explanation: 200 °C par Kc 5500 aur yield 98% hai, magar reaction itni slow hai ke munasib waqt mein equilibrium tak nahi pohanchti. 400-500 °C par V₂O₅ catalyst ke saath rate zyada hai aur yield (75% se 61%) ab bhi achhi hai; garam hone ke baad gases ko is kam temperature par recycle karne se bacha hua SO₂ bhi zyada badal jata hai.

blocks.caption: Quick Check 8.6: Kp of three equilibria at different temperatures
header: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g), ΔH° = −92 kJ mol⁻¹, Kp = (pNH₃)² / pN₂(pH₂)³: Kp/atm⁻²
N₂O₄(g) ⇌ 2NO₂(g), ΔH° = +57 kJ mol⁻¹, Kp = (pNO₂)² / pN₂O₄: Kp/atm
2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g), ΔH° = −197 kJ mol⁻¹, Kp = (pSO₃)² / (pSO₂)² pO₂: Kp/atm⁻¹

blocks.prompt: i) Temperature barhne par N₂/H₂/NH₃ system mein ammonia ka hissa kaise badalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Kam hota hai. Table mein Kp 400 K par 1.0 × 10² se 800 K par 7.9 × 10⁻⁶ tak girta hai; Kp chhota matlab ammonia kam.

blocks.prompt: ii) Is reaction ka ΔH° kya hai, aur 400 K par Kp kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Table ke mutabiq ΔH° = −92 kJ mol⁻¹ (exothermic), aur 400 K par Kp = 1.0 × 10² atm⁻².

blocks.prompt: iii) Le Chatelier ke principle se batayein ke temperature barhane ka is reaction ke Kp par kya asar hoga.
blocks.explanation: Reaction exothermic hai, is liye temperature barhane se reverse (endothermic) reaction ko faida hota hai: equilibrium left shift hota hai aur Kp kam hota hai, jaise table dikhati hai.

items: 2SO₂ + O₂ ⇌ 2SO₃ exothermic hai (taqreeban −198 kJ): kam temperature par Kc bara aur yield zyada (200 °C par 98%) magar reaction slow; zyada temperature par tez magar yield kam (700 °C par 31%).
Optimum conditions: SO₂ aur hawa 1 atm par V₂O₅ par; gas 600 °C tak garam hoti hai, is liye mixture 400-500 °C par recycle hota hai.
